records.description: TradeRing is an AI receptionist for UK trades—builders, plumbers, roofers, and electricians. When you’re on a job or driving, TradeRing answers within 2 rings, qualifies leads, and books appointments 24/7 straight into your schedule.

records.name: whynba
records.tagline: Your Fv nba site
records.description: Independent NBA explainers, team and player profiles, and a closer look at the numbers. Basketball from every angle, on whynba.

records.name: Plasmanica: Gradient Engine for Designer
records.tagline: Free plasma & mesh gradients, animated or still
records.description: Plasmanica is a free, in-browser studio for plasma and mesh gradients. Hit Surprise me, tweak colours and motion, then export 4K images, seamless MP4 loops, wallpaper packs or a tiny embed for HTML, Webflow and Framer. No sign-up, no watermark.

records.name: Notaty
records.tagline: Turn any voice into notes, flashcards and a quiz
records.description: Notaty records your lecture and turns it into a timestamped transcript, a summary, flashcards and a quiz. Works in English and Arabic, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Apple Watch recording. Free tier included.

records.name: Notelyf
records.tagline: Plan your day, focus deeply, and study together
records.description: Notelyf brings notes, to-dos, plans, budgets, and focus tools into a workspace you can make your own. Choose your widgets, theme, and background, then work solo or join an open study room. Inside a room, your notes, tasks, and timer stay yours. Mic and camera are optional, so you can focus alongside others without changing how you work.

records.name: Fractax
records.tagline: Manage Multiple digital certificates in one app
records.description: Fractax is a privacy-first desktop app for freelancers and agencies to manage multiple digital certificates simultaneously. No more incognito windows or constant logouts. Every certificate runs in its own isolated environment with dedicated sessions and tabs. Switch between identities with one click. Fractax automatically monitors official government notifications and expiration dates across all profiles. 100% local and secure—your keys never leave your PC. Free for up to 2 certificates.

records.name: DR Checker
records.tagline: Check any site’s Ahrefs Domain Rating for free
records.description: DR Checker gives you a free Ahrefs Domain Rating lookup without signup. Enter a domain to see its DR score and a plain-English interpretation. For larger lists, check up to 100 domains at once and export the results as CSV. The site also includes free tools for domain authority, domain age, and Google search snippet previews.

records.name: Grow — Baby Tracker
records.tagline: Your baby’s feeds, sleep, diapers and growth in one place
records.description: A feed, a nap, another diaper. Grow keeps the little details of your baby’s day together with timers, notes, reminders and daily, weekly and monthly summaries. Track feeding, sleep, diapers, growth and milestones in a warm watercolor interface, with separate records for multiple babies. Available for iPhone, iPad and Android in 18 languages. Free to download; full access requires a subscription, with a one-week trial for eligible users.

records.name: Releasy Suite
records.tagline: Every signal from your product, in one place.
records.description: Hookfire, Upvoted and Indie Polls in one place. Alerts from your stack, feature voting from your users, and embeddable polls. One login, one bill, $69/mo.

records.name: ScreenToast
records.tagline: Turn your Mac screen recording into a product demo
records.description: ScreenToast is a Mac screen recorder for product demos: auto zoom on clicks, a smooth cursor, vertical recording and drafted narration. Free until you export.

records.name: SparkyDraw
records.tagline: SparkyDraw is a simple, delightful drawing app for children
records.description: SparkyDraw is a simple, delightful drawing web app designed for children (and not only!), compatible with any device and screen format (touch, pen/pointer & mouse friendly) and in any orientation. It remembers your artwork and settings across visits, exports high-resolution PNG images locally and adapts easily in small or big screens, in both portrait and landscape modes! SparkyDraw supports multiple languages (with more to be added). As a lightweight progressive web app, it also works offline.

records.name: Retro
records.tagline: Team retrospectives with clear actions and Linear hand-off
records.description: Reflect together, group ideas and turn decisions into actions with owners and due dates. Sign in with email or Linear; invite guests by link. Publish selected actions to Linear, or export PDF and JSON. Free plan available.

records.name: AI Usage Tracker
records.tagline: Every AI limit. Right in your notch.
records.description: Always-on-top Windows edge pill showing your Claude, Codex, Cursor, FreeBuff, Github Copilot and Antigravity limits - aswin-dg/usage-meter-for-windows

records.name: Brand on AI
records.tagline: See how AI describes your brand
records.description: Brand on AI checks how ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini answer questions about your brand. Generate a report, inspect the questions and original answers, compare a relevant competitor, save your history, and monitor changes each week. You can start with a free report and keep using the free plan.

records.name: TALARIA EBIKE USA
records.tagline: Talaria komodo sports
records.description: 2025 Surron Light BeeX If you are looking to get a dirt bike from talaria website, kindly reach out now and place an order

records.name: PairNeo
records.tagline: Where real professional connections begin.
records.description: Connect on PairNeo with people who are the right fit for you. Discover shared interests, share posts, and join events. For people and businesses. Start for free.

records.name: feedback-memory
records.tagline: Make Claude Code remember why you rejected its drafts
records.description: An open-source MCP server and Claude Code plugin that gives your agent a memory for your corrections. Approve, edit or reject a draft and it saves your one-line reason in a local Postgres + pgvector (PGlite). Before the next draft it recalls your rules and the closest past corrections, and the plugin's hooks add them to your prompts on their own, so the agent can't forget to check. Works in Cursor and Claude Desktop too. MIT, nothing to host, plus a browser demo.

records.name: Vortex AI
records.tagline: A native, lightweight Gemini AI client for Windows
records.description: Vortex AI is a native, ultra-lightweight desktop client for Gemini on Windows. Built for performance and zero browser tab clutter, it features dark mode UI, smooth animations, and optimized background proxy connectivity.

records.name: Vyorah
records.tagline: Turn your life history into patterns and forecasts
records.description: Vyorah is AI-assisted personal life forecasting that finds recurring patterns in your life-event history and creates interpretive forecasts from your own history.

records.name: 10 AI Agents That Can Automate Your
records.tagline: 10 AI Agents That Can Automate Your Daily Work
records.description: Discover AI agents that can take repetitive tasks off your plate, from organizing information to completing routine workflows. Explore practical tools that can help you spend more time on meaningful work. https://giftcard-sged.surge.sh

records.name: Solvane Technologies
records.tagline: Solve. Build. Advance
records.description: Solvane Technologies is a technology and digital solutions company founded by Yash Singh alongside co-founders Alwin Mathew (CTO) and Yuvraj Singh (COO). Engineering high-performance websites, web applications, mobile platforms, and digital design.

records.name: VidPlanner Automation
records.tagline: social media scheduling
records.description: Automate your social media with VidPlanner - AI-powered Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube automation. Schedule posts, grow your audience, and save time with our powerful automation platform.

records.name: Colorize Old Photos
records.tagline: Colorize and restore old photos with AI, pay once
records.description: Turn black and white old photos into natural color in seconds. AI colorizes and repairs scratches, fading and blur — free preview, no sign-up.

records.name: Marine Loan Calculator
records.tagline: Free boat loan calculators with state sales tax built in
records.description: Calculate your boat loan payment, interest, and total cost free. Includes state sales tax, trade-in value, and a full amortization schedule no signup.

records.name: AURA
records.tagline: A free Linktree alternative with a video made just for you.
records.description: AURA turns your links into a page that feels like a front door. Paste your Linktree URL to move everything in seconds, get a background video generated just for you, and add optional nature-sound music. Free forever, no sign-up.

records.name: health updates
records.tagline: Get Any Update About Health
records.description: Health Updates is a UK-focused health and wellness website providing informative content on health, diet and nutrition, exercise, weight loss, mental health, pregnancy, skincare, dental care, and related topics. The site publishes practical guides and articles designed to help readers better understand health choices, treatments, clinics, and everyday wellbeing.

records.name: SurfiTools
records.tagline: SurfiTools — Free & Paid Software Downloads
records.description: SurfiTools is the official download store for Surfi software: crypto mining tools, the Surfi Browser, the Surfio media player, a VPN and everyday utilities. Download free tools straight away, or buy once with Bitcoin, Ethereum, TRON or USDT — no subscriptions.

records.name: CINEMATIC REEL DIRECTOR
records.tagline: AI TOOL FOR CONTENT CREATORS
records.description: New option for a reels creations

records.name: Overlaysmith
records.tagline: Add one image overlay to browser video calls
records.description: A Chrome extension that puts one image — a banner, a title, a logo, a lower third, a frame — on your outgoing webcam video in browser video calls. Bring your own, type one, or describe one to the AI image tool you already use. No account, no cloud, no subscription. Your video goes to your call — and nowhere else. The meeting is theirs, the frame is yours.

records.name: Mesmora Jewelry – Timeless Sparkle
records.tagline: Timeless Moissanite Jewelry for Every Special Moment
records.description: Discover Mesmora Jewelry, a modern collection of elegant moissanite jewelry created for engagements, weddings, celebrations, gifting, and everyday style. Explore beautifully designed rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and timeless pieces that combine brilliant sparkle, contemporary elegance, and meaningful design for every special moment.

records.name: REPYH Founder Types
records.tagline: A 5-minute adaptive test that names your founder blind spot
records.description: Two founders can look identical on paper and be nothing alike. This adaptive 5-minute test places you on four dimensions (crowd, approval, risk, motivation) and gives you one of 22 founder types, blind spot included. Free, no sign-up, English & Chinese.

records.name: QRtracer
records.tagline: Dynamic QR codes. Edit links after printing. Track scans.
records.description: Print once, update the destination whenever you need. QRtracer combines dynamic QR codes with scan analytics, so you can compare posters, menus, packaging and campaigns from one dashboard. Customize your codes, track scan activity and change links without reprinting. Free static tools, bulk generation, an API and MCP integration cover one-off tasks and automated workflows. Start free.

records.name: TradesAd Suite™ — Rule
records.tagline: Know if your ad will get flagged — before you pay for clicks
records.description: Deterministic, rule-based ad-copy audits for residential contractors and agencies. Same ad in, same verdict out — every time.

records.name: Fruit Merge Game
records.tagline: Merge fruits, build combos, and chase your best score
records.description: Fruit Merge Game is a free browser-based puzzle game where you drop and merge matching fruits to create larger ones and chase a higher score. It features 25 fruits, four evolution routes, three strategic tools, physics-based movement, and a danger-line system that makes each run harder. Play instantly on desktop or mobile with no download required. The site also includes fruit evolution guides, strategy tips, and gameplay information.

records.name: ResizeFox
records.tagline: Free online tools to resize, compress and convert images
records.description: Use our free image resizer to change JPG, PNG and WebP dimensions in your browser. Compress images or edit and convert PDFs, with no signup.

records.name: Rice purity test
records.tagline: Take the Rice Purity Test — 100 Questions, Instant Score,
records.description: Take the original Rice Purity Test from Rice University. 100 honest questions, free, no sign-up, instant score. Find out where you actually stand.

records.name: The 6-Day YouTube Accelerator
records.tagline: YouTube Accelerator
records.description: This done-for-you email course gives your customers a proven, easy-to-follow system for launching and growing successful YouTube ad campaigns. It teaches them how to build strong ad strategies, create videos that get attention, target the right audience, and turn viewers into loyal customers. As they learn, it also helps you upsell your services and position yourself as an expert.

records.name: Ranomio
records.tagline: Random Password Generator Dice
records.description: Ranomio — The Fast, 100% Private & 3D Decision and Draw Suite (or: "Cryptographically secure random tools with 3D physics, multilingual alphabets, and zero server logging.")

records.name: Needlee
records.tagline: Everything you need to keep track of your pattern progress
records.description: Upload a pattern, map its grid, then mark the stitches as you work them. Daily goals and weekly totals keep your progress clear.

records.name: Quiet Holiday
records.tagline: Avoid school & public holidays, travel in the quiet weeks
records.description: School holidays, half terms and public holidays worldwide, weighted by how many people are off – so you can book your trip in the quiet weeks.

records.name: Uzo Labs
records.tagline: The Infrastructure Layer for BOT Chain
records.description: SDKs, templates and infrastructure that take developers from zero to shipped on BOT Chain. Built in Lagos.

records.name: DaoDaily
records.tagline: Track habits at your desk. Leave your phone alone.
records.description: Your habits belong in your life, not on your phone. DaoDaily is a free browser habit tracker: check in at your desk, close the tab, and get back to your day. Try the public demo before signing up. Want a break from every screen? Make a 7-, 14- or 30-day printable tracker without an account. Demo marks reset and don't transfer to your account. Paper tracking is separate and doesn't sync with the app.

records.name: ListingCopy
records.tagline: Shopee + Mercado Livre listing copy in Portuguese
records.description: ListingCopy helps Brazilian marketplace sellers turn product bullets into ready-to-paste titles, descriptions, tags, and hashtags for Shopee and Mercado Livre — in one flow. Offline-first rules/templates (no paid API required). Optional local LLM / your own API key. Includes a 50-template niche pack (home, kitchen, electronics, beauty, pet). Built for affiliates and high-volume sellers who hate rewriting the same ad copy. One-shot download. Not a listing agency; no rank or sales promises.

records.name: StlFixTool
records.tagline: Convert and repair 3D and CAD files, pay per file
records.description: Online STL, STEP, OBJ, GLB and 3MF conversion plus mesh repair. Every job runs a verification pass — watertightness, manifold edges, solid count — and shows you a 3D preview before you pay. If the output isn't usable, you see that first. $2.99–$5.99 per file, no subscription, no account.

records.name: ONSITE NOW
records.tagline: A live-location social feed for bars, cafes & airports, etc
records.description: Live, real-time posts from people physically at each place. See what's happening right now.

records.name: Million Miles
records.tagline: Every mile counts
records.description: Million Miles is a free iPhone and Apple Watch app with one shared goal: to walk and run a million miles together. Whether you're just starting out, walking to the shops or an experienced runner, every mile adds to the community total. Record on your phone or watch, or bring in walks and runs from Apple Health. Start a team with friends, take on challenges, cheer each other on and collect badges along the way. No leaderboards, no ads, no subscription. Every mile counts.

records.name: Zextiria Rooms
records.tagline: Turn client calls into approved scope changes
records.description: A shared room for each client project. Clients join from a link, no account needed. AI agents, ours or your own like Claude, work from the same document, and scope changes from calls become edits that apply only after someone approves them.

records.name: Leveld
records.tagline: Stay on top of work and life - your AI project manager
records.description: Whether you're running a multi-million-pound project or just your personal admin, every ask you send or receive should be logged, followed through and closed. That's Leveld. It reads your email, documents actions and decisions, flags risks like an expert over your shoulder, and chases the overdue with one click — you stay in control. Not inbox zero. Not another chatbot. A clean, separate space with the list you've always wanted. Gmail now, more soon. Free beta, 20 spots.

records.name: GitHub
records.tagline: Show a single Win app window in any web browser on LAN
records.description: Show a single Windows application window in any web browser on your local network - eugenyh/WindowStream

records.name: Synthient
records.tagline: Know which proxy or VPN is behind an IP
records.description: Most IP reputation tools stop at 'proxy: true.' Synthient identifies the provider and network behind residential proxies, commercial VPNs, relays, Tor, and bot infrastructure, then returns behavior signals, timestamps, and risk scoring through an API, bulk feeds, or a live firehose. It is built for fraud, abuse, trust and safety, and security teams that need evidence they can act on.

records.name: Humandex
records.tagline: AI on your side: see and shape what recruiters find
records.description: Hiring: years of experience, reduced to keywords. Systems scan resumes. AI searches the web. Machines decide who gets seen by humans. Humandex reveals what AI knows about professionals—and what it misses. It turns public information into profiles backed by sources and human confirmations, with AI visibility checks, peer comparisons, and recommendations for improvement. Apparently, doing good work isn't enough anymore. The machines need to notice.

records.name: Mahjong Logbook
records.tagline: Leaderboard for Mahjong Group
records.description: Free score tracker for your mahjong game. Create leaderboard, trend charts and head-to-head records for your friend group or club. No sign-up, No install. Supports all kind of Mahjong.

records.name: Staff Style
records.tagline: Bespoke Staff Uniforms London & Nationwide
records.description: Bespoke staff uniforms across London, Manchester, Glasgow & UK. Stylish, durable workwear for hotels, restaurants, bars & housekeeping staff. Enquire today.

records.name: Cloudflare Containers
records.tagline: Serverless containers, rebuilt for agent sandboxes
records.description: Cloudflare rebuilt its Containers product to run agent-driven sandboxes. Containers now start 6x faster, agents can pick each sandbox's image and instance type at runtime, and filesystem snapshots are in public beta, all controlled from a Durable Object.

records.name: 0x8 Post-Quantum Cryptographic Suite
records.tagline: Video Call, Screen Sharing, Chat, File Transfer (WebApp)
records.description: 0x8: Browser-native Post-Quantum Cryptographic Suite (Video Call, Screen Sharing, Chat, File Transfer) implementing NIST-standardized algorithms at the highest security level: ML-KEM-1024 (FIPS 203) • Kyber-1024, ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204) • Dilithium-87, SLH-DSA-256 (FIPS 205) • Sphincs+, FN-DSA-1024 (FIPS 206) • Falcon

records.name: FreemiumAssets.com
records.tagline: Every Brand. Consistent Variants.
records.description: Find ready-to-use brand logos in SVG and PNG variants — Primary, Black, White, and Outline.

records.name: Sentry for Windows
records.tagline: See what fills your drives in one local storage map
records.description: Sentry maps your Windows drives and folders so you can find large files and decide what to keep. Scan several locations together and save the last completed map. Free and open source, with no account needed for local scanning. Optional Google Drive access requires your own Desktop OAuth client. Windows x64; unsigned installer.

records.name: QuantumCV
records.tagline: Build an ATS-ready resume with AI, in minutes.
records.description: QuantumCV makes resume building faster and smarter with AI-powered generation, live chat-based editing, ATS optimization, and 30+ professional templates. Create, customize, and improve your resume in one place—built especially for students, freshers, and job seekers.

records.name: Fancy Font Maker
records.tagline: Turn plain text into 105+ cool fonts in one click
records.description: Meet Fancy Font Maker ✨ Just enter your text, browse the available styles, and copy the one you like. Type → Choose → Copy → Paste You can create text like: 𝓕𝓪𝓷𝓬𝔂 𝓣𝓮𝔁𝓽 𝕱𝖆𝖓𝖈𝖞 𝕿𝖊𝖝𝖙 𝐅𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐲 𝐓𝐞𝐱𝐭 𝑭𝒂𝒏𝒄𝒚 𝑻𝒆𝒙𝒕 Ｆａｎｃｙ Ｔｅｘｔ It's designed for creating stylish text for Instagram bios, TikTok captions, gaming usernames, Discord profiles, Facebook posts, WhatsApp messages, and other social profiles. 🌐 Try it free: https://fancyfontmaker.com/

records.name: Mario Pepper
records.tagline: mario pepper
records.description: Challenge friends in Mario Pepper, the multiplayer trivia game for iPhone and Android. Answer fast, earn Peppers, climb leaderboards and prove who knows the most.

records.name: FeverMate
records.tagline: Fever diary and dose timing. No ads, no account.
records.description: 2 a.m. fever: last dose, next dose, mg vs ml, two parents, a dark room. Rolling 24-hour log of temperatures and doses. Tracks the gap between doses and converts mg to ml from the leaflet numbers you type. Two phones pair over Bluetooth. Night screen. 18 languages. Not a medical device. You enter the dose; the app does not invent one. No account, no ads, nothing leaves the phone. Free.

records.name: Code verse learn programming
records.tagline: Coding programming learning
records.description: 🚀 LEARN PROGRAMMING — Your journey to becoming a better programmer starts here! 💻 Learn Programming Languages, DSA, OOP, Frameworks, Databases, Developer Tools, Career Roadmaps, Real-World Projects, and more. 🧠 Test your knowledge with interactive quizzes and build practical skills. 🎯 Everything you need to learn programming in one place. Whether you're a beginner or improving your skills, start learning, build skills, and build your future! 📲

records.name: NFSh Corporate Crime Risk Response
records.tagline: Rule-based response to corporate crime indicators
records.description: NFSh Corporate Crime Risk Response is a bilingual rule-based legal tool for organisations in Saudi Arabia. It helps structure an initial response to corporate crime indicators and conduct preventive control reviews by organising known facts, verification gaps, alternative explanations, evidence preservation points, actions to avoid, and suitable initial next steps. The tool does not determine that a crime occurred, assign liability, or automatically decide whether a report should be filed.

records.name: Tenvar
records.tagline: Turn private recordings and documents into cited reports
records.description: Bring recordings, documents and notes into one private workspace. Transcribe locally, ask questions with citations you can inspect, and turn selected evidence into reports with playable audio and video excerpts. Your reader needs only a browser. Import Obsidian vaults; Apple Notes import is Mac-only. Windows, macOS and Linux. Free: one project plus one imported library. $59 USD once unlocks unlimited projects and libraries. Models run on your computer; setup downloads are separate.

records.name: MNC Review Copilot
records.tagline: AI-powered performance review & feedback generator for MNCs
records.description: Struggling to write professional English performance reviews or corporate feedback for your MNC team? Meet MNC Review Copilot—an AI-powered assistant designed for managers and engineering leads. Type your rough notes in your native language, select your desired tone (Executive, Constructive, or Praise), and instantly generate polished, objective, STAR-compliant corporate feedback. Built with Next.js and deployed on Vercel. Try it now and streamline your management workflow! 🚀

records.name: BUMBI
records.tagline: Learn play earned kill repeat but with fun
records.description: BUMBI — an endless ink-carnival run-and-gun. Five modes, a travelling armory, parries, and a show that does not end.

records.name: MRT Announcements
records.tagline: A talking Singapore MRT map for little train fans
records.description: An interactive Singapore MRT map for little train fans. Tap any of 143 stations to hear it announced, then the doors closing. Made by a mum for her son.

records.name: Allowly
records.tagline: Policy checks and signed receipts for AI agent actions
records.description: Allowly checks your rules before an AI agent sends, spends, publishes, changes, or deletes. Get an allow, deny, confirm, or escalate decision and a signed receipt you can verify offline. Connect through API, Python, TypeScript, MCP, n8n, Make, or Zapier. Your integration executes only allowed actions. Start free with 1,000 decisions; no card required.

records.name: AppReleaseKit
records.tagline: App Store screenshots in every language, export-ready
records.description: Your screenshots are the first thing people see on the App Store. AppReleaseKit helps you make them unforgettable. Start from a finished template, drop your app into real 3D devices, and make it yours with 6,000+ stickers, icons, and elements. Design once, translate into 27 languages with the help of AI, then export every App Store and Play Store size in a single click. Just beautiful screenshots, ready to ship.

records.name: Hadir
records.tagline: A quiet prayer companion for your Mac’s notch
records.description: Hadir helps Muslim professionals keep up with prayer while they work on Mac. It lives quietly in the menu bar and notch, showing the next prayer, daily prayer times, Hijri dates, reminders, and Du’a & Dhikr. No noisy dashboard. Just a calm reminder when it matters.

records.name: WebSnarks Google Business Profile Check
records.tagline: Free Google Business Profile audit for local businesses
records.description: Audit your Google Business Profile in minutes. See what's missing or weak, from categories to photos to reviews, and get a PDF report with clear steps to rank higher in local search and Google Maps.

records.name: Fabius
records.tagline: One dashboard that tells you what needs you
records.description: Fabius connects to the apps you work in and tells you what needs you: one prioritized list, a morning brief, and an AI you can ask about your work. Read-only by design, so it never changes anything. Free to start.

records.name: TheraChat
records.tagline: 24/7 Secure AI Mental Health Hub. 12 Virtual Psychologists.
records.description: TheraChat is a secure AI mental health platform accessible 24/7. Switch between 12 specialized virtual psychologists with distinct therapy styles and premium voice capabilities. Built with zero-disk audio caching in RAM, hybrid Google Gemini & Groq neural network matrix for anti-crisis stability, and smart memory models that securely retain client context over months. Lowering barriers to psychological support globally via a Pay-What-You-Want indie ecosystem.

records.name: Bead Pattern
records.tagline: Turn photos into printable Perler and Hama bead patterns
records.description: Turn photos into editable Perler, Hama and fuse bead patterns in your browser. Adjust colors, draw on the grid and check bead counts before making your project. Photo conversion and editing are free; Google sign-in enables saved projects and PDF, PNG, SVG and bead-list downloads, plus one free AI image generation.
